# Archive format and document icon coverage

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/format-icon-coverage.py` from docs/format-icon-coverage.json. Do not edit. -->

Arkiv identifies archives by their content. A name only chooses the icon, the
suffix of a new archive, and which files form a split 7z set. This table is enforced by
`tests/test_format_icon_coverage.py` and `Tests/ArkivThemesTests/DocumentIconArtworkTests.swift`.

* **Finder icon** is what Finder draws **when Arkiv is the default app for that type**
  (Get Info → Open with → Change All). Otherwise Finder draws the default app's icon.
  Finder types a file by its last extension only.
* **Inside Arkiv** is the artwork Arkiv's own windows use (archive rows, title bar, Archive
  Info, Settings previews) for the selected document icon theme. Names are matched case-insensitively,
  longest suffix first.

| Name | Format | Engine | Created as | Finder type | Finder icon | Inside Arkiv | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `archive.zip` | ZIP | read, create, edit (ZIP32) | `.zip` | `public.zip-archive` | ZIP | ZIP | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.7z` | 7z | read, create | `.7z` | `org.7-zip.7-zip-archive` | 7z | 7z | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.rar` | RAR4/RAR5 (single volume) | read only | — | `com.rarlab.rar-archive` | RAR | RAR | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.tar` | TAR | read, create | `.tar` | `public.tar-archive` | TAR | TAR | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.gz` | GZIP (single file) | read, create | `.gz` | `org.gnu.gnu-zip-archive` | GZIP | GZIP | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.bz2` | BZIP2 (single file) | read, create | `.bz2` | `public.bzip2-archive` | BZIP2 | BZIP2 | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.xz` | XZ (single file) | read, create | `.xz` | `org.tukaani.xz-archive` | XZ | XZ | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.zst` | Zstandard (single file) | read, create | `.zst` | `org.zstandard.zstd` | ZSTD | ZSTD | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.tgz` | TAR + gzip | read, create | `.tgz` | `org.gnu.gnu-zip-tar-archive` | TGZ | TGZ | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.tar.gz` | TAR + gzip | read, create | `.tar.gz` | `org.gnu.gnu-zip-archive` | GZIP | TAR.GZ | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.tbz2` | TAR + bzip2 | read, create | `.tbz2` | `public.tar-bzip2-archive` | TBZ2 | TBZ2 | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.tbz` | TAR + bzip2 | read | — | `public.tar-bzip2-archive` | TBZ2 | TBZ2 | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.tar.bz2` | TAR + bzip2 | read, create | `.tar.bz2` | `public.bzip2-archive` | BZIP2 | TAR.BZ2 | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.txz` | TAR + XZ | read, create | `.txz` | `org.tukaani.tar-xz-archive` | TXZ | TXZ | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) |
| `archive.tar.xz` | TAR + XZ | read, create | `.tar.xz` | `org.tukaani.xz-archive` | XZ | TAR.XZ | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.tzst` | TAR + Zstandard | read, create | `.tzst` | `org.zstandard.zstd` | ZSTD | TZST | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.tar.zst` | TAR + Zstandard | read, create | `.tar.zst` | `org.zstandard.zstd` | ZSTD | TAR.ZST | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.7z.001` | Split 7z volume | read, create (2-128 parts) | `.7z.001` | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | 7z-volume | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.7z.002` | Split 7z volume | read (opened from any volume) | — | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | 7z-volume | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.7z.0123` | Split 7z volume | read | — | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | 7z-volume | Supported; Arkiv shows dedicated artwork. Finder types the name by its last extension, so it shows the family icon (or the system icon for a numbered volume) |
| `archive.part1.rar` | Multipart RAR first volume | rejected (multipart RAR is milestone 5) | — | `com.rarlab.rar-archive` | RAR | RAR | Planned or unsupported format: no claim, no registration, no dedicated artwork in use — Still a .rar file, so it keeps the RAR icon; the preserved RAR-volume artwork is not used until multipart RAR is supported. |
| `archive.r00` | Legacy RAR volume | unsupported (milestone 5) | — | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | system icon | Planned or unsupported format: no claim, no registration, no dedicated artwork in use |
| `archive.z01` | Split ZIP volume | unsupported (milestone 6) | — | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | system icon | Planned or unsupported format: no claim, no registration, no dedicated artwork in use |
| `archive.zip.001` | Split ZIP volume | unsupported (milestone 6) | — | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | system icon | Planned or unsupported format: no claim, no registration, no dedicated artwork in use |
| `archive.001` | Unknown numbered file | not identified by name | — | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | system icon | Not an archive type Arkiv can identify by name: never claimed |
| `notes.txt` | Not an archive | - | — | none (dynamic type, never claimed) | system icon | system icon | Not an archive type Arkiv can identify by name: never claimed |
| `release.tar` | TAR | read, create | `.tar` | `public.tar-archive` | TAR | TAR | Supported and correctly mapped (Finder and inside Arkiv) — A name containing 'tar' without a compressor suffix stays TAR. |

Uppercase and mixed-case names (`ARCHIVE.ZIP`, `Archive.Tar.Xz`) map exactly like lowercase ones.
